Name: Sweet Mod
Author: 3wisellamas
Description:
Very simple mod that does two things:
[list]
[*]Replaces the bald male farmer sprite with Sweet (of Sweet Cap'n Cakes fame) from Deltarune.
[*]Adds Sweet's hat and headphones as an optional hat, sold at the Hat Mouse for 100g as soon as their shop opens.
[/list]
And that's it!  Very simple like I said.

Mod requirements:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ (of course!)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url]﻿ (and its requirements as well).
[/list]
Not required, but HIGHLY recommended for a better experience:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17220]Brightonmorris1's No Blink[/url]﻿ (Without this you'll get that ugly blinking animation that most anthro / nonhuman farmer replacements have)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10094]Therealtime34's Deltarune Tasque for SDV[/url]﻿ (Replaces your pet cat with a Deltarune Tasque!)
[/list]
Installation:
[list]
[*]Unzip and paste both the "[b][CP] SweetMod[/b]" and "[b][JA] SweetMod[/b]" folders into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[/list]
I also definitely recommend using hair #53 for Sweet, the true bald hairstyle. 

Mod HAS been tested pretty extensively with other mods, including with Fashion Sense.  The only conflicts you should run into are anything that also modifies the bald farmer sprite SPECIFICALLY (most others should be fine).  This is my first mod, and I am not planning to release any updates.  Enjoy!

Sweet by Nelnal and Toby Fox (of whom I am neither).
